title: Raina J NDE 4092
content: Much of the auto accident is blurry. I remember flashes of white surrounding me as paramedics try to get me out of the vehicle, and voices. I am in pain, then out of pain in darkness. There is a time when I am in darkness, floating in something like fluid with red curves around it. I am content and relaxed just floating. There are other people around me, just floating, just as content. Then I hear voices again of people asking me questions, probably in the emergency room. I am unconscious again in darkness, and then I awaken in a large 'void' gray area. Muted light seems to be coming from above me, but there is no source. I am floating above other people, in an upright position. There are people above me and below me, vertically, and as I look directionally right down the row of people, there seem to be thousands upon thousands in the same formation. We are all silent. At the moment of awakening, there seems to be a feeling of something being pulled back or 'peeled' from my eyes and face. I reach down to touch the person below me and to my left. She has red hair. I want to ask her where I am. As I reach down, I am called. At first, the man in front of me is approximately thirty feet away from me. He appears to be flooded with white light in a white suit, bald, with extremely white teeth. He floats me out of formation, then in front of him. He is not in a white suit, but he is 'glowing'. Inner light is flowing out all round him. He has extremely blue eyes. I am so happy to see him! I know him and he knows me. I cannot recollect who he is now. I hug him and tell him I miss him. He tells me it is not my time. I disagree! I see a line of people going through a dark tear in the fabric of the void and a man stares at me. In fact, there are other people milling about on the 'floor' who have very puzzled looks on their faces, which are slightly blurred to me. I am puzzled too. I want to go where the other people are going, but again, I am told it is not my time. I point again, to where the people are going. The man points to the upper right corner of the void and I am suddenly back in my body. I know I am there because there is someone telling me, 'You scared me to death! Don't you ever do that to me again'. I awoke to find myself in a scanning machine. I don't know for sure, but it must have been the x-ray tech and my brain scan must have flat-lined! After that, I was back - in pain, but back. What does it all mean? Why didn't I see the light?

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes AccidentDirect head injury Concussion Other Auto accident where I was in a coma, but in and out of the other side. Auto accident.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Void | Darkness | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Less consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I was reaching down for the lady with red hair. When I was talking to the man.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I felt as if I had been there for a very long time.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: There was no sound. When the man spoke, it was inside my mind.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes The man and other people who were just as puzzled as I was. I believe we were all communicating telepathically.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The man. I'm not sure who he was. Although I am a Christian, I don't believe it was Jesus. I think it may have been an ancestor.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Puzzlement, contentment, and I really, really wanted to stay. Love. I forgot about my family totally.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes GOD IS SO MUCH MORE - WE ARE SO MUCH MORE.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes GOD IS SO MUCH MORE - WE ARE SO MUCH MORE.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes Just that it wasn't my time. It was irritating!
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes Some people think I have flipped my lid. I don't talk about it much.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Some people think I have flipped my lid. I don't talk about it much. After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I think the first time I went back, I was back in the womb, or a womb-like place. I know the man was significant to me, but I have no idea who he was.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes A long time. People who are spiritual believe me. People who are not, do not and think I'm nuts, or that I had a bad head injury. No one is influenced.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes I heard it was possible.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I realized that there was life after death, although I didn't know how to tell anyone. I realized that there must be a God, and that there is definitely more beyond this life. I was inspired, but so puzzled about what we hear about Heaven. This wasn't Heaven. I'm sure if it. But, I'm still not sure what it is - I think about it every day.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I remember as though it happened yesterday. I remember everything so vividly. If you are in a coma, isn't it just supposed to be dark? If you're dreaming, aren't you supposed to feel as though you are dreaming? It was not always dark, and there was no dreaming.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: After the experience, I have endured horrible depression and anger. I don't understand how someone twenty-three could have wished to stay there, but I sure did.
